title: AESCULATECH HEADLINES STAGE AT PLUG AND PLAY LA TECH WEEK
summary: AesculaTech was one of a few selected companies showcased at Plug and Play’s 2022 LA Tech Week. Roby Menefee, Head of Material Development, shared the company vision of smart materials as a way to personalize products across a range of industries. AesculaTech’s Humidifeye and Detox nail polish stole the show!
